newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE may bring more assets to Havas-paper. [CORRECTED 18:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CGE may bring more assets to Havas-paper. [CORRECTED 18:40 GMT]

text.p: Water-to-telecoms group Compagnie Generale des Eaux (CGE) may bring publishing group Havas its money-losing Generale d'Images unit and other assets in addition to a 19 percent stake in Canal Plus, the newspaper Figaro reported on Wednesday.
CGE officials were not immediately available for comment, but CGE and Havas said this week that they were discussing their audiovisual interests, notably Canal Plus.
Generale des Eaux may also contribute its Compagnie generale de videocommunication subsidiary or its 10 percent stake in Canal Satellite, the newspaper said.

It said CGE chairman Jean-Marie Messier had approached Albert Frere at Groupe Bruxelles-Lambert about purchasing the stake in Havas (corrects from Canal Plus) held by Alcatel Alsthom in the event that Alcatel sought to divest.
Details of the operations set between Havas and Canal Plus are expected to be made public on Thursday.
